memory_candidates.content: In a Lean modal-logic library where 5 of N shared axiom schemata each require a distinct frame condition (reflexivity/seriality/symmetry/transitivity/Euclideanness) to be valid while the rest are frame-unconditional, a single uniform per-tag obligation function (e.g. `FrameValidatesTag (m) : Tag -> Prop`, `True` for the unconditional tags and the exact frame-hypothesis shape for the conditioned ones) lets one master soundness combinator (`unionSound (S) (m) (hfc : forall t in S, FrameValidatesTag m t) ...`) discharge every case via `cases t with | tag => ... exact ExistingLemma m hval ...` -- no conditional/unconditional split at the type level, no re-derivation of the frame arguments. This composes cleanly with a semantics library that already exposes each frame-condition-to-validity correspondence as an explicit-hypothesis lemma (rather than a typeclass instance), since the master combinator can pass the obligation's proof straight through as that lemma's explicit argument.

For a Finset-indexed union predicate `SchemaUnion (S : Finset Tag) : Prop := exists t in S, t.Holds`, providing three @[simp] elimination lemmas -- `SchemaUnion empty_iff : SchemaUnion (empty) phi <-> False`, `SchemaUnion insert_iff : SchemaUnion (insert t S) phi <-> t.Holds phi \/ SchemaUnion S phi`, and `SchemaUnion union_iff : SchemaUnion (Sa union Sb) phi <-> SchemaUnion Sa phi \/ SchemaUnion Sb phi` -- lets `simp` unfold a concrete `SchemaUnion {t1, t2, ...} phi` (built via Finset insert/union notation) into the named disjunction of its tags' Holds clauses, replacing raw `fin_cases t <;> simp_all` destructuring at every downstream consumption site with named rewrites. Build this API once alongside the combinator's definition, not per-consumer.
